flows:
Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:8765/examples/demo-shop/?lang=ar then Open any product, add it to the cart, open the cart and start checkout.
Go through every checkout step until the order is placed. On each step, fill in realistic details for a customer in a Arabic-speaking country. Where a field shows an expected format or an example, follow it exactly.
On each page, before you click its main button, verify that the page is fully usable in Arabic: the whole button is visible, with no part of it cut off by the edge of its box or of the screen, and nothing covers it; the button and the page's labels and messages are written in Arabic (no code-like keys, no leftover placeholder text); every value you typed in the format the page asked for was accepted; and every price, shipping cost and total shown looks plausible for this shop and adds up. Then click it.
Verify that an order confirmation appears.
If a verification fails, @v16:"fail the test at that point."

summary:
The page places its fixed bar on top of the main checkout button instead of leaving enough space for the button to remain fully visible and usable.
Adjust the checkout layout so fixed bottom content reserves space for the primary button, then verify at supported viewport sizes that the entire Arabic “متابعة” button remains visible and unobstructed.
